# Core (required)
numpy>=1.24
scipy>=1.10
pandas>=2.0
matplotlib>=3.7
scikit-learn>=1.2

# Testing
pytest>=7.4

# --- Optional, feature-gated dependencies ---
# The framework runs fully without any of these; each is only used by the
# specific optional code path named below, and every call site guards the
# import so its absence never breaks the core pipeline.
#
#   torch          -> optional NeuralUCB contextual bandit variant in
#                      pir_controller.py (LinUCB/Thompson Sampling, the
#                      defaults used by evaluate.py, are pure NumPy).
#   wfdb           -> PhysioNetRecordLoader in data_pipeline.py, for reading
#                      real MIMIC-III/PTB-XL WFDB records. Not required for
#                      the synthetic-data evaluation pipeline used by
#                      evaluate.py by default.
#
# Install with:  pip install torch wfdb
